messages:
Maya Singh: quick update — please welcome Tanya Alvarez, who will be joining as Head of Observability (product + platform overlap) starting Mon 2026-04-06. She's coming from ScaleMetrics where she led infra observability teams. :tada:

Maya Singh: org changes tied to this hire — Observability team will now report into Eng Platform (from Eng Infra). This is to tighten product->serving telemetry and accelerate rollout of quality-driven alerts. Two immediate backfills approved (Senior Observability PM + Staff SRE). Hiring reqs are in Greenhouse: REQ-4891 and REQ-4892.

Devon Miles: awesome — congrats Tanya! quick Q: does this change on-call ownership for runtime incidents or just reporting line?

Maya Singh: good Q — on-call stays under Eng-SRE for now, but Tanya will be co-owned for alert definition, runbooks, and eval signal routing. we'll formalize the split this week.

Carlito Reyes: huge win. Tanya's expertise with signal and cost tradeoffs should help with our observability cost story. Welcome! :raised_hands:

Alex Chan: adding to Friday all-hands agenda — 5m intro and Q&A. Tanya, would you like to share 2 slides on priorities? cc @Maya Singh to set up.

Tanya Alvarez: hi everyone — super excited to join. priorities first 90 days: 1) align alerts to SLOs, 2) reduce noisy alerts by 30%, 3) telescope cost hotspots for serving GPU clusters. happy to grab slides, thanks for the warm welcome. :wave:

Maya Singh: FYI people-ops approved immediate ramp for hiring and approved interim budget for two contractors for cross-team runbook work. hiring links below and initial on-call note:

Maya Singh: ```
Runbook sync: Wed 10am PT (recur weekly)
On-call handoff doc: https://internal.redwood/rb/oncall-observability
Hiring reqs: https://greenhouse.garden/REQ-4891
```

recruiter-bot: REQ-4891 (Senior Observability PM) marked HIRING by People Ops at 2145001590

Devon Miles: thanks — will update SRE rotation matrix. can someone add me to the runbook sync calendar?

Maya Singh: adding you now. :white_check_mark:

Tanya Alvarez: thanks Devon, see you Wed. feel free to DM me any immediate pain points you want on the agenda.

Alex Chan: great coordination — let's make sure we publish a short note to #eng-news after the all-hands so other teams know about the reporting change.

Maya Singh: will post the eng-news blurb after Friday. again, welcome Tanya! :sparkles:
